## qa-test-reporting v1.8.0

- Major update: Skill documentation and reporting structure revised for clarity and traceability.
- SKILL.md reworked: clearer principles, stricter report structure, and explicit rules for conclusions and risk sections.
- Reporting templates and audience-needs references added for easier report customization (`assets/report-templates.md`, `references/audience-needs.md`).
- Outdated skill-card removed; migration to more detailed metadata.
- Enhanced traceability and requirements for output content (IDs, reference values, and minimum report sections now more explicit).
- Guidance and documentation now match upstream skill ecosystem structure and terminology.

qa-test-reporting v1.7.0

- Removed obsolete file: skill-card.md
- Updated SKILL.md content, including possible improvements or clarifications to documentation and structure
- No functional changes to the skill logic reported

- Added skill slug and displayName fields to SKILL.md for improved metadata and consistency.
- Updated version to 1.6.3.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No changes to core logic or report content.

Version 1.6.0 of qa-test-reporting introduces traceability and reporting standards improvements.

- Added explicit traceability requirements: each report must include a unique ID and aggregate related use case, defect, and requirement IDs.
- Defined new output format fields for traceability and report structure.
- Clarified depth quantification: minimum core sections specified, with recommendations for tailoring depth by audience.
- Introduced error recovery guidance—fallback to quality metrics if key audience concerns are missed.
- Specified category tags and improved structure for standards compliance.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Improved description to clarify audience needs and report adaptation for different roles
- Added version field in SKILL.md
- Standardized input and output formats in SKILL.md for clearer data requirements and output structure
- Replaced section "Examples" with "输出示例"，and "Guidelines" with "检查清单"
- Removed outdated file: skill-card.md

- Updated skill description for clarity and conciseness.
- Removed redundant details from SKILL.md; streamlined introduction and usage trigger.
- No logic or template changes; all report structures and templates remain the same.
- Deleted outdated skill-card.md file for clean-up.

- Expanded keywords and trigger phrases in description and when_to_use, improving discoverability for more reporting scenarios.
- Upstream related skill qa-defect-lifecycle replaced with qa-bug-lifecycle for better alignment.
- Added more keywords to description (如测试摘要、覆盖率报告、报告模板、质量可视化).
- Small language adjustments to clarify scenarios where skill is applicable.
- Removed redundant file skill-card.md.

- Expanded and clarified usage scenarios and trigger keywords for generating test reports, including daily, weekly, iteration, and special reports.
- Added comprehensive, structured templates and content outlines for daily reports, weekly summaries, iteration reports, and specialized testing reports.
- Provided clear definitions for input and output formats, as well as related and dependent skills.
- Included practical report examples and post-report quality check guidelines.
- Improved documentation to better support both test teams and management-level report consumers.
